`src/indieweb/` contains Django IndieAuth, Micropub, and Webmention logic, plus management, templatetags, templates, and static assets. `tests/` mirrors app modules and holds fixtures; use `tests.settings` via `DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE`. `docs/` is Sphinx; `examples/`, `example_project.py`, and `client.py` provide integrations and smoke-test helpers.

Commands (keep exact):
- Install: `uv sync` or `just install`
- Test: `uv run pytest` or `just test`; focused: `uv run pytest tests/test_file.py::TestClass::test_case -v`; fast: `pytest -k "keyword"` or `just test-one path::node`
- Typecheck: `uv run mypy` or `just typecheck`
- Lint/format: `uv run ruff check .`; `uv run ruff format .`
- Full matrix/hooks: `tox` or `tox -e pre-commit`
- Docs: `just docs` (builds Sphinx HTML and opens locally)

Python 3.10+; 4-space indentation. Prefer explicit typing; annotate public functions/classes. Ruff rules: `E,W,F,I,B,UP,DJ`; line length 119, double quotes. Names: modules/files and functions/methods `snake_case`, classes `PascalCase`, Django settings/constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Avoid unused symbols/dead code. Keep app boundaries: views/handlers in `indieweb`, templates in `templates/indieweb/`, assets in `static/indieweb/`.

Add behavior and focused regression tests under `tests/` as `test_*.py`, mirroring module paths. Tests use coverage (`--cov-config=pyproject.toml`) and reuse the DB; reset or mark transactional tests when changing schema. Prefer fixtures over duplicated inline setup. Migrations: `indieweb/migrations/`; run and test them for schema changes.

Beads: database `.beads/` at repo root; keep daemon off with `BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1` and `BEADS_DIR="$PWD/.beads"`. On starting a bead, mark in progress: `bd update <bead-id> --status in_progress`; read context/deps: `bd --no-daemon --no-db show <bead-id>` and `bd --no-daemon --no-db dep tree <bead-id>`. Read any referenced spec/PRD before changing code. Beads comments’ first non-empty line must be `Ready for review:`, `LGTM`, or `Changes requested:`; include summary and validation. Avoid `bd sync` unless asked; in worktrees prefer `bd --no-daemon sync --flush-only`. Beadsflow implementer `codex`, reviewer `claude`; configure in `beadsflow.toml` or `BEADSFLOW_IMPLEMENTER`/`BEADSFLOW_REVIEWER`. Use local checkout `../beadsflow`, not packaged release (e.g. `uv run --project ../beadsflow beadsflow run <epic-id> ...`).

Commits: short imperative subject, scoped. Before PR run `uv run pytest`, `uv run mypy`, and `uv run ruff check .`; include notable outputs. PRs describe change, user impact, tests, and related issues; attach screenshots/API samples for user-facing changes. Update docs/examples for endpoints, handlers, or settings toggles; state migration implications. Never commit secrets or tokens; use environment variables for client IDs, tokens, target URLs. Validate endpoint/handler input early; keep external HTTP calls behind clear typed interfaces (see `indieweb` client patterns).

When ending a work session, you MUST complete ALL steps below. Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds.
1. File issues for remaining work.
2. Run quality gates (if code changed): tests, linters, builds.
3. Update issue status: close finished work, update in-progress items.
4. PUSH TO REMOTE (MANDATORY):
`git pull --rebase`
`git status  # MUST show "up to date with origin"`
5. Clean up: clear stashes, prune remote branches.
6. Verify all changes committed AND pushed.
7. Hand off context for next session.
Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds
NEVER stop before pushing - that leaves work stranded locally
NEVER say "ready to push when you are" - YOU must push
If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds
